asr.full_text: Hey guys! My name is Elena. I'm a graphic designer and this is my channel for beginners in Adobe Illustrator and in a graphic design. Guys! I am teaching you Adobe Illustrator. And of course you want to know how and where you can earn money to have income with help of this knowledge. And today I am going to show you five ways to earn money with help of Adobe Illustrator, and one of them my. And if you're interested First way is Photo Bucks! Photo Bucks are a libraries of million photos, videos and designs where any designer can sell his photos, videos or designs. And this is worth and has my way to earn money on Adobe Illustrator. About first 5 years of my designing career, I have been earning money only on photobanks. And now I have clients and me and my husband have our own family project but photo bumps still one of mine incomes about seven to eight hundred euros I have your photo banks it's a very good place for beginners photo banks don't have exams and you can upload your work immediately after you sign up and start to sell your designs. For me best banks are Adobie stock and Shooter stock . I have more than 10000 designs on Adobe stock and 6000 designs 6,000 designs on Shutterstock. You'll find links to my profiles under this video, if you're interested to hear more about photobanks please let me know in comments below. The second way is Markplaces. marketplaces,places is like your promotion at the work. Its place is already not for beginners, unlike photos banks. If you want to sell your designs of your marketplaces, you need to have strong skills in Adobe illustrator. But again unlike photo banks, on marketplaces you can earn more money, because people know what the quality on marketplaces will be the best. And you can sell your design by your own price unlike photo banks. When I had found... when I'd figured out about marketplaces, I'd already had clients and our family project but if I knew about it before, I'd definitely tried to earn there. And one of the best marketplaces, in my opinion, is En easy. The third way is online print shops, for example, you want to order a shirt or socks with an interesting design and face mask and shower curtains. You can do this on online print shops. One of the best is RedBubble. I many times ordered their stuff and it was a pretty good quality. As a designer with Adobe Illustrator skills, you can create designs here and sell them. Here also, you don't need exams or approving on your designs by Administrator of Redbubble, you just create designs and people will decide, buy it or not! A few years ago I for fun bought my designs at the shop and they were selling here. Now you see some of my designs on redbubble's website. 4th way is a creating fonts. I think not many of you knows that fonts are created in Adobe Illustrator. And you also can earn money on it with Adobe Illustrator. But for the creating a font you need plugin, fontsolvesmaker or other, it's not free, it cost 39 euro, its 1x fee. Where you can sell fonts? I can advise you Myfonts, fontshop, fonts. And the fifth way is Etsy. Etsy is an American ecommerce website focussed on handmade or vintage items and craft supplies. These items fall under a wide range of categories including jewelry, bags, clothing, home decor and furniture, toys, art, as well as craft supplies and tools. And what you can sell here with the help of Adobe Illustrator. For example you can sell these mugs but on Etsy you sell the whole product. You need to have not only a design but and marks as well, and Buyers write you their names for example they can send you their photos and you can create characters who look like them. Or you can sell like this wedding invitations. Also, you can sell any clothes. Or you can create these cute personalized books. OK, guys. That is all for today. Hope my video was useful for you. If you like my video please give me a like, subscribe and see you in the next video about a Graphic Sign and the next tutorial in Adobe Illustrator bye bye guys !
